name: Sentrixa Anti-Spam
author: Sentrixa Systems Ltd

sections.description:
Sentrixa Anti-Spam blocks bot and human spam on comment forms without relying on any third-party service. Everything runs on your own server — no data ever leaves your site.

Free features

  • Honeypot trap — a hidden text field is added to the comment form. Automated bots that fill every field are blocked silently.
  • Required hidden fields — comments posted straight to WordPress without using the comment form are blocked (can be switched off for custom comment forms).
  • Timing check — comments submitted faster than the configured minimum time are blocked (bots submit instantly; humans take a few seconds to read and type).
  • Per-IP rate limiting — limits the number of comments an IP address can post per hour and per day.
  • Keyword blocklist — one phrase per line; matched case-insensitively against the comment text, author name, and email address.
  • Email domain blocklist — block comments from known disposable or spam email providers.
  • IP blocklist — block exact IPv4 or IPv6 addresses.
  • Link-count cap — block comments containing more than a set number of links.
  • Blocked-comment log — the last 100 blocked attempts are shown on the settings page, with the reason, IP, author, email, and a text excerpt.
  • Custom block message — configure the text shown to the commenter when their comment is blocked.

All settings live at Settings > Anti-Spam in the WordPress admin.

External services

This plugin contacts no external services. All spam checks run locally on your server. No data is sent anywhere.
